meta.note: Frozen Qualified AI Visibility panel for the AIO KPI framework. Built from real GSC queries (thinkjinx.com), Ahrefs keyword volumes, live AI-retrieval research, and reconciled against Jinx client history (HQ id 47, meeting recaps, launch briefs). Do not edit prompts without bumping panel_version; measurement continuity depends on a stable panel.

client_context.account_lens: AWARENESS-FIRST by design (HQ directive learning 5775). Paid is deliberately weighted to awareness/engagement/traffic; near-zero purchases and ROAS are intentional. This reframes AI-Referred Conversions (KPI 5) as a directional/secondary metric for Jinx, not a scorecard headline; branded-search lift and store visits are the truer outcome signals.
client_context.live_client_ask: Caitlyn requested an 'AI visibility score' with graphs and prompt examples (HQ context 11778, 2026-07-20); client floated an off-page AI/SEO package (PR, Reddit ads, Quora, YouTube SEO). This framework maps directly onto that ask.
client_context.positioning: Simple high-quality ingredients, clean label + probiotics, named proteins, digestion/firmer-stool, bone-broth hydration (cat). Leaning into VALUE given the economy. Female founder Terri; Dr. Nitido vet voice; celebrity face is Chris Evans (NOT Will Smith).
client_context.tentpole: Build the Best Bowl (BBB) spans kibble + homemades + toppers; toppers/kibble sauce are the strategic wedge.
client_context.seo_theme_pivot: As of 2026-06-23/24 client moved AWAY from broad 'can my dog eat X' content TOWARD allergies/sensitivities, protein & picky eaters, senior dog, and cat. Panel reflects this (dropped the cucumbers content-magnet prompt, added senior).
client_context.audience_skew: 70% female target on Meta/TikTok/YouTube (HQ learning 5778); millennial-women skew on cat. Personas tagged accordingly.

sov_competitor_set.rationale: Research 2026-07-24: LLMs place Jinx in the premium-kibble + toppers + retail space (picky eaters, meal toppers, best-at-Walmart), never in fresh-subscription answers. The Farmer's Dog/Ollie/Spot & Tango are a different niche; track as aspirational context, not head-to-head. Added Stella & Chewy's (dominates picky-eater + topper answers) and Nulo. Client-history check (HQ context/learnings + all meeting recaps + 4 launch briefs) names NO specific competitor, so this set is research-derived, not client-dictated; Matthew's focus on 'competitive switching signals' makes the comparison prompts (weight 3.0) especially high-value.
